name: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts: SV - AMUR - sniper rifle
summary: Developed in cooperation with snipers from several Russian elite Special Forces units. It is intended for precise individual target engagement at ranges up to 1000 meters. A small stock of these rifles were confiscated by Siberian Wolves and are now available on the black market.
